title: 第十九章 你这人还挺奇怪第二十章 不就是一碗饭吗
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
“叶晚秋，你怎么知道赤凰草种之前需要用火炙烤种子？这方法你是在哪里看来的？”药尘子着急问道。
叶晚秋看着披头散发不修边幅的药尘子，下意识后退拉开了些许位置。
“我、我就是之前听说的！既然那些种子发芽了就好。”
叶晚秋内心松了口气，她也算是将之前不小心吃掉的赤凰草补上了。
看来系统说的没错。
[宿主不必客气。]系统伞伞的声音在她脑海里响起。
“听说的？”药尘子眉头都快要拧成一个‘川’字了，“在哪里听说的？山下？那些凡人怎么可能见过赤凰草……”
见药尘子嘀咕，叶晚秋一个字都不敢多说，生怕对方究根问底，她不小心说漏嘴。
“那什么，长老，既然赤凰草长出来了，那我是不是就不用赔了？”叶晚秋小心翼翼的问。
拔了那些赤凰草，把这药尘子气得够呛，崔向阳和游星几人也一直奔波，想办法帮她弥补，叶晚秋心里挺过意不去的。
“不用！”药尘子大手一挥，“我没做好药园的防护阵法，你才不小心走了进去，误把赤凰草当成了野菜，这件事咱们两个都有错。”
他顿了一下，继续说道：“还有一件事，是我该向你道歉，你炙烤赤凰草，我不仅没懂，还朝你发脾气……”
叶晚秋连忙开口：“没有没有，是我没有说清楚，才让长老你误会的。”
她想的是系统当时给的办法过于离奇，她心里也拿不准主意。
而药尘子则是觉得哪怕当时叶晚秋说了，自己在愤怒之下也不会相信。
药尘子恨不得给自己脑袋再来一下，这脑子怎么就不中用呢！
他更加自责了，摸摸自己的袖子，从里面掏出来一个小瓷瓶，“叶晚秋，这个给你！”
“这是什么？丹药？”
叶晚秋接过，看着瓶子有些眼熟，好像游星之前给她辟谷丹的瓶子。
她打开盖子，一股清香的味道扑面而来，隐约可以看到瓶子里的圆圆的丹药。

药尘子大咧咧往旁边的椅子上一坐，“洗髓丹，你不是凡人吗？用了这丹药，就可以修炼了。”
“啊？这也太珍贵了，我不能要！”叶晚秋连忙将手里的瓶子推回去。
药尘子愣住，一时间分不清她说的‘珍贵’是真的，还是在阴阳怪气自己。
他连忙坐直身体，神色郑重道：“你这是不满意？叶晚秋，其实我手里确实有不少好丹药，但是你一个凡人，拿了也没用，这洗髓丹最合适不过！”
“不是……”
叶晚秋想起自己没有灵根的事情，连忙摆手拒绝：“不了，我没想着修炼，就是平时爱做做饭，再说了，我都一把年纪了，还哪里还想着修炼的事情……”
药尘子听到这话，忍不住嘶了声。
“叶晚秋，你这人还挺奇怪的，那普通人要是有修炼的机会，恨不得拼了命也要进各大修仙门派，想要长生不老。
现在我都把这个机会放在你面前了，你要是服了这丹药，便可洗髓，哪怕是杂灵根，也可以修炼一些基础心法，延年益寿，健身健体，不成问题。”
见叶晚秋不说话，药尘子继续道：“哎，你想想，你如果有了灵力，哪里还用劈柴烧火？想要做饭的话，捏个诀，火就出来了。想要种菜，捏个水诀，浇水也省事。哪怕是搬东西，也可用灵力解决……”
他越说，叶晚秋越是觉得有道理。
content_en:
"Ye Wanqiu, how do you know that the seeds of Red Phoenix Grass need to be roasted with fire before planting? Where did you see this method?" Yao Chenzi asked anxiously.
Ye Wanqiu looked at Yao Chenzi with disheveled hair and subconsciously stepped back a little.
"I-I heard it before! It's good now that those seeds have sprouted."
Ye Wanqiu breathed a sigh of relief. She had finally made up for the red phoenix grass she had accidentally eaten before.
It seems that the system is right.
[Host, you don’t have to be polite. ] The voice of the system umbrella sounded in her mind.
"Have you heard about it?" Yao Chenzi's brows were about to twist into the word "Chuan", "Where did you hear about it? At the foot of the mountain? How could those mortals have seen Red Phoenix Grass..."
Seeing Yao Chenzi muttering, Ye Wanqiu didn't dare to say a word more, for fear that the other party would ask for the truth and she would accidentally spill the beans.
"What about that, elder? Since the red phoenix grass has grown, do I not have to pay compensation?" Ye Wanqiu asked cautiously.
After pulling out those red phoenix grasses, Yao Chenzi was so angry that Cui Xiangyang and You Xing kept running around trying to find ways to help her make up for it. Ye Wanqiu felt very unhappy.
"No need!" Yao Chenzi waved his hand, "I didn't prepare the protective formation of the medicine garden, so you accidentally walked in and mistook the red phoenix grass for a wild vegetable. We are both at fault for this."
He paused and continued: "One more thing, I should apologize to you. You roasted the red phoenix grass. Not only did I not understand, I also lost my temper at you..."
Ye Wanqiu said quickly: "No, no, it was me who didn't explain clearly that made you misunderstand, elder."
What she thought was that the method the system gave her was too bizarre, and she couldn't make up her mind.
Yao Chenzi felt that even if Ye Wanqiu had said it at that time, he would not have believed it in anger.
Yao Chenzi wished he could give his brain another blow. Why was this brain useless?
He blamed himself even more, touched his sleeve and took out a small porcelain bottle, "Ye Wanqiu, this is for you!"
"What is this? Pill?"
Ye Wanqiu took it and looked at the bottle that looked familiar, like the bottle that You Xing had given her before.
She opened the lid, and a refreshing smell hit her face, and she could vaguely see the round pill in the bottle.
Yao Chenzi calmly sat down on the chair next to him, "Marrow Cleansing Pill, aren't you a mortal? You can practice with this pill."
"Ah? This is too precious, I can't have it!" Ye Wanqiu quickly pushed back the bottle in his hand.
Yao Chenzi was stunned, and for a moment he couldn't tell whether the 'precious' she said was true, or whether she was just blaming herself.
He quickly sat up straight and said solemnly: "Are you dissatisfied? Ye Wanqiu, actually I do have a lot of good elixirs in my hand, but as a mortal, it's useless to take them. This marrow cleansing elixir is the most suitable!"
"No..."
Ye Wanqiu remembered that he had no spiritual roots, and quickly waved his hand to refuse: "No, I don't think about cultivation, I just like to cook. Besides, I am already old, so why should I still think about cultivation..."
When Yao Chenzi heard this, he couldn't help but hissed.
"Ye Wanqiu, you are quite strange. If ordinary people had the opportunity to practice, they would risk their lives to join the major cultivating sects in order to live forever.
Now I have put this opportunity in front of you. If you take this elixir, you can cleanse your marrow. Even if you have miscellaneous spiritual roots, you can also practice some basic mental methods to prolong your life and keep fit. It will not be a problem. "
Seeing that Ye Wanqiu was silent, Yao Chenzi continued: "Hey, think about it, if you had spiritual power, why would you still use your spiritual power to chop wood and make a fire? If you want to cook, just make a trick, and the fire will come out. If you want to grow vegetables, make a water trick, and watering will be easy. Even if you have to move things, you can use your spiritual power..."
The more he talked, the more Ye Wanqiu felt it made sense.
